title: session-record v1
description: Horde's own record of one session. Every field is an answer in core/Tristate.ps1's stored form - known with a value, absent, or unknown with a reason - so an unknown is a first-class part of the record, never a sentinel. A field the record has not asked about yet is left out; a field it asked about and could not answer is recorded as unknown, with the reason. The field list is core/ownership.json's, and test/test-schema-session-record.ps1 fails if the two ever differ. Only schemaVersion and sessionId are required.

sessionId.description: The conversation id: the record's identity, so a plain value and never an answer. Owner: agent (core/ownership.json).
